plugin.note: Wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet against Banshees or take 6 damage and heavy stat drain per scream. Their Defence is low, so any decent melee works. Air spells exploit the 30% elemental weakness for a magic alternative.

requirements: 15 Slayer is required to harm Banshees (69 for Twisted Banshees).
Combat level 20 is required for assignment.
Priest in Peril must be completed to enter the Slayer Tower.
Earmuffs or a Slayer helmet must be worn to avoid the stat-draining scream.
mechanics: Attacking without earmuffs or a Slayer helmet deals 6 damage and greatly drains Attack, Strength, Defence, Ranged, Magic, Prayer, and Agility.
Banshees are undead and spectral: the salve amulet and Crumble Undead apply.
Banshees have a 30% elemental weakness to air spells (Twisted Banshee 25%).
Twisted Banshees regenerate 1 Hitpoint each time they are attacked.
They attack with magical melee at 4 ticks.

methods.label: Melee with earmuffs
methods.summary: Wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet and kill the ground-floor Banshees with any melee weapon.
steps: Complete Priest in Peril and travel to the Slayer Tower.
Equip earmuffs (or a Slayer helmet) before attacking.
Kill the eastern ground-floor Banshees; their low Defence makes weapon choice unimportant.
notes: A Slayer helmet gives the Slayer damage bonus and doubles as the earmuffs protection.

methods.label: Air spells
methods.summary: Cast air spells to exploit the 30% elemental weakness while still wearing earmuffs.
steps: Wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet.
Attack Banshees with air spells or a trident to hit the elemental weakness.
notes: Twisted Banshees regenerate 1 HP per attack, so keep damage per hit high.

styleOptions.label: Melee with earmuffs
styleOptions.summary: Any decent melee with earmuffs or a Slayer helmet worn.

styleOptions.label: Air spells
styleOptions.summary: Air spells exploit the 30% elemental weakness.
